survivors.description: Inverts module name check so globals come from the wrong place.
survivors.diff:
--- a/mashumaro/jsonschema/schema.py
+++ b/mashumaro/jsonschema/schema.py
@@ -660,3 +660,3 @@
     module_name = getattr(owner_type, '__module__', None)
-    if module_name:
+    if not module_name:
         globalns = getattr(sys.modules.get(module_name, None), '__dict__', {})
survivors.words: mashumaro/jsonschema/schema.py:661: changing `    if module_name:` to `    if not module_name:` made no test fail; not compared with the fix: no compared function in its file
